CustomField.description: Full event address on one line, built from the Event location fields. Blank unless Type = Event.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Event"), IF(ISBLANK(Event_Venue__c), "", Event_Venue__c & ", ") & IF(ISBLANK(Event_Street__c), "", Event_Street__c & ", ") & IF(ISBLANK(Event_City__c), "", Event_City__c & ", ") & IF(ISBLANK(Event_State__c), "", Event_State__c & ", ") & IF(ISBLANK(Event_Postal_Code__c), "", Event_Postal_Code__c & ", ") & TEXT(Event_Country__c), NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Full event address on one line, built from the Event location fields. Blank unless Type = Event.
CustomField.label: Event Address
